prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity portrait iPhone app Home screen for Forkware, edge-to-edge screen only, no device frame or external background. Reference screenshot supplies ONLY existing palette, Barlow Condensed display font, SF body type, native iOS chrome and tonal component character; do not copy its Plan content or large panel verbatim. Warm ivory #F7F3EA canvas, charcoal #191918 text, peach #F3AD88 primary fill with charcoal labels, deep peach #984C31 links. Crisp native controls, generous 44pt targets, no photos, illustrations, gradients or ornamental icons. Top iOS status area, header Home with small Forkware context and gear Settings icon top right. Bottom native five-tab bar exactly Home, Plan, Recipes, Shop, Assistant; Home selected. Fit actual screen at roughly 402x874 logical points, output portrait aspect ~0.46. Text should be legible and restrained, strong hierarchy, no huge empty header space. Upcoming meals must lead. Sample data is illustrative for the concept. No pantry inventory, expiry or stock claims. Render enough of the screen to show recipe discovery and shopping. Composition A, AT A GLANCE: Header uses native large Home title. First section 'On the menu' with 'View plan' trailing. A single compact CHARCOAL panel with three spacious rows separated by fine quiet rules: 'Tonight' / 'Garlic-herb chicken' / 'Dinner for two'; 'Tomorrow' / 'Beef tacos'; 'Thursday' / 'Pizza night'. Each has a small chevron, tonight line subtly peach; no large hero button in this variant. Then a spacious section 'Find your next favorite' with an ivory native search field 'Search your recipes', followed by two full-width distinct native action rows 'Browse recipes' with book symbol and 'Create with Assistant' with conversation symbol, subline 'Turn an idea into a recipe'. Last a compact shopping row on cream 'Your shopping list' and '8 items left · next 2 weeks' with basket icon and chevron. Keep three domains visible above tab bar with clear whitespace and only one dark area. This is a native meal app, not a dashboard grid.
